toxicity.Notes: Text (Fig. S13 in the SI): LD50 16.3 +/- 4.0 mg/kg i.v. in ICR mice over 15 days; all mice at doses up to 40 mg/kg died by day 6 (as worded); cisplatin LD50 4 mg/kg; normal weight gain in survivors; no efficacy study in vivo in the main text. Read from the SI received 2026-11-16 (Fig. S13): 5 mice per dose followed for 16 days. Survival is 100 % at 5 and 10 mg/kg, 20 % at 20 mg/kg and 0 % at 40 mg/kg, where the deaths fall between days 4 and 6. This corrects the earlier reading of the main text, which was taken to mean that every mouse up to 40 mg/kg died by day 6. Body weight rises in every surviving group, so there is no weight loss.
